title: Add reusable Excel export for saved report configurations
description: Customer downloads the current authorized preview page of a saved draft or pinned published revision through one shared endpoint and exporter. Export endpoint re-executes IReportConfigurationExecutionService with authenticated user; never trust client rows, identity, scope or cached preview. Reuse installed NPOI. Generic exporter consumes common preview columns/rows/evidence with no dataset-specific dispatch. Include definition name/version, dataset/grain, normalized query filters/date range, current-page coverage, currency/unit semantics, read-only limits and unknown-value explanation even when related display fields are omitted. Fresh source bounds/cancellation and authorization apply before response; permission loss, invalid revision, unavailable persistence and export failure return controlled errors without stale download. Numeric signed values remain numeric, null unknown stays blank with explanation, dates/booleans remain correctly represented and text cannot become Excel formulas. Group subtotals are current-page only and separated by currency; no all-match total. Add generic workspace download button and retain unsaved controls on failure. Stage 1 unified platform only; existing sales-order/receivable adapters are engine fixtures, not migration or new bespoke reports. Preserve old report entries until every fixed/dynamic report passes Stage 2 parity. No Agent or cross-business flow work. Server-authenticated identity and fresh existing menu/field/row/data scope remain authoritative, saved definitions/grants never grant ERP permissions. No arbitrary SQL, scripts, joins, tables, mixed currency/unit totals or one-to-many header duplication. No migrations, SchemaUpgrader/SeedData modifications, production SQL/database execution, schema/view/procedure changes, secrets/.env/config changes, deployment or irreversible operations. Use existing HTTP and entity audit conventions. Safe build/test and relevant offline integration tests required; missing actual DB/browser/font environment must be explicitly blocked, never claim the phase complete from build. Preserve unrelated source/work.
acceptance_criteria: One authenticated generic Excel endpoint re-runs saved configuration preview and fails closed on invalid/revoked access or unavailable environment.
Reusable workbook preserves selected order/types/nulls and formula-safe text with mandatory query, currency, scope and current-page evidence.
Customer workspace downloads the generic workbook and meaningful offline API/workbook/UI tests pass configured safe build/test.
